description: Gives a team's playoff chances from a week ago and earlier, one a week, each as of its day. It also says what moved the chance most: the change between two days and the matches played between them. Call it for how a team's playoff chances have changed, or what its chances were last week. Pass the team, or nothing for the member's own team. It never gives today's chance: the `project_standings` tool gives that, with the Desk Pass.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

team.description: The team, e.g. 'Belvedere men's 7.5'. Omit for the signed-in member's own team. Or the team's Desk page link or number.

name: query_playoff_history
title: Past playoff chances
